settings.hero_desc: A scale model of a fuel storage tank - large cylindrical tanks with stairways and walkways, reproduced to scale on a branded base. A clear, professional way to present a storage facility to clients, partners and investors.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your facility layout, branding, scale and base plaque
settings.s1_body: A storage tank farm is impressive on site and just as impressive in miniature. We reproduce the tanks, stairways, walkways and layout to scale on a branded presentation base, so clients and investors can grasp your facility instantly. The ideal centrepiece for boardrooms, exhibitions and reception displays for oil, gas and industrial companies.
settings.case_body: Built as a branded scale model, this storage tank farm let an industrial company present their storage facility to clients and partners without leaving the room - a tangible, on-brand centrepiece that explained the operation at a glance.
settings.case_quote: We used this model to showcase in MakeIT Exhibition. Thanks to the model it was easier to explain our storage facility to visitors.
settings.prov_p: Fuel Storage tanks are critical infrastructure that acts as a supply buffer to store fuel, oil, gas and chemicals. They provide safe storage that helps keep demand and supply in balance.
